 THIS CRL.P IS FILED U/S 482 CR.PC PRAYING TO QUASH THE FURTHER PROCEEDINGS IN C.C.NO.1386/2020 (ARISING FROM CR.NO.50/2019 OF MANGALORE WOMENS POLICE STATION) ON THE FILE OF JMFC III COURT, MANGALORE, D.K.
FOR THE ALLEGED OFFENCES P/U/S 498A, 504 R/W 34 OF IPC.
 THIS PETITION, COMING ON FOR ADMISSION, THIS DAY,
THE COURT MADE THE FOLLOWING:
 ORDER Heard Sri. Venkatesh Somareddi, learned counsel appearing for the petitioners, Sri.Mahesh Shetty,
the learned High Court Government Pleader appearing for respondent No.1 and Sri.Deviprasad Shetty, the learned counsel for respondent No.2.
2.
The petitioners call in question the proceedings in C.C.No.1386/2020 registered for offences punishable under Sections 498A and 504 read with Section 34 of IPC.
During the pendency of this petition, the parties to the lis have settled the dispute amongst themselves and have drawn up certain conditions of settlement.
One such condition is the closure of the impugned proceedings.

The condition insofar as it recognizes the closure of these proceedings reads as follows:

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
The plaintiff has agreed to withdraw Crl.M.C.No.83/2019 under Section 12 of the PWDV Act, 2005, on the file of the Court of J.M.F.C II Mangalore, D.K., filed by her against defendant and his parents on the basis of this compromise petition/decree subject to payment of permanent alimony as agreed in para 5.
7.

The plaintiff and defendant and his parents shall also file compromise petition in C.C.No.1386/2020 on the file of J.M.F.C.III Court Mangalore, D.K., which was initiated by the plaintiff by filing FIR No 0050/2019, against the defendants and his parents for the offence mentioned therein."

4. In the light of the settlement arrived at between the parties and the offences being ones punishable under Section 498A and 504 of IPC not being against the State, I deem it NC:
2023:KHC:20323 appropriate to accept the settlement and terminate the proceedings, qua the petitioners.
5. For the aforesaid reasons, the criminal petition is disposed.
The proceedings in C.C.No.1386/2020 on the file of J.M.F.C. III Court, Mangalore, D.K., stand quashed.
